day_shape: 53 items: Trump tells Fox News of IRGC backchannel and threatens to bomb Oman over Hormuz, reported US-Iran 60-day ceasefire extension, Kushner-Blair-Mladenov pressing Netanyahu on Gaza phase two, Houthi missile claim on Saudi vessel, heavy IRIB/Defa Press output, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Trump Iran backchannel and Oman threat
threads.summary: Trump told Fox News he has a backchannel with IRGC officials and is in "no hurry" for a deal, while threatening to "heavily bomb" Oman if it obstructs Washington over the Strait of Hormuz. The Jerusalem Post reported the US and Iran agreed to extend the ceasefire by 60 days; IRIB and Defa Press amplified the Oman bombing threat and claimed US "defeat" in the region.

threads.label: Iran signals shift to offensive posture
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post cited a senior Iranian official saying Tehran has decided to shift from defensive to "fully offensive" policy given the deadlock with Washington, and reported Iran had viewed the MOU period as US-Israeli stalling to prepare a larger attack. Iran separately barred two French embassy employees involved in a July diplomatic dispute from returning.

threads.label: Kushner-Blair Gaza phase-two push
threads.summary: Jared Kushner, Nikolay Mladenov and Tony Blair met Netanyahu and senior Israeli officials to press for the next stage of Trump's 20-point Gaza plan, following Kushner's Cairo meeting with senior Hamas leaders that left Ramallah officials perplexed. Israel and the US agreed that in the initial Hamas disarmament stage weapons will be transferred to the ISF for destruction; Hamas's Iran representative said weapons remain a legitimate tool of resistance.

threads.label: Gaza ceasefire incident and Red Sea claim
threads.summary: The IDF reported a Hamas explosive device detonation and gunfire in the Yellow Line area of northern Gaza with no Israeli injuries, and said it struck the area in response. Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed ballistic-missile attacks on a Saudi military vessel and four escort boats off Al-Mokha in the Red Sea, and Yemen's Foreign Ministry warned Riyadh of reciprocal response.

threads.label: Khamenei fortieth-day and domestic messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office promoted the slogan "We are committed to you until the dawn of appearance" for fortieth-day memorials of the "Martyr of Iran" and circulated a leader message urging trust in officials of the three branches. Defa Press and IRIB carried IRGC Deputy Commander Izadi's Journalists' Day remarks, Pezeshkian's "Digital Iran" student address, and First VP Arif warning against a repeat of last December's unrest.

events.title_en: Trump threatened to bomb Oman
events.summary_en: Trump threatened to bomb Oman. The US President threatened that if Oman obstructs Washington, his country will heavily bomb it. Donald Trump, the US President, on Monday in an interview with Fox News, in response to a question about Iran-Oman negotiations regarding control of the Strait of Hormuz, threatened that if Oman obstructs Washington, his country will heavily bomb it. The delusional US President spoke about the end of the 60-day deadline of the Islamabad agreement and once again repeated his anti-Iran wishes. He again claimed that there is a communication channel with Iran. Trump also claimed that regarding Iran there is urgency and a specific timetable.

events.title_en: Foreign Policy: America in Iran's quagmire
events.summary_en: Foreign Policy: America in Iran's quagmire. Foreign Policy magazine wrote: A war of attrition with Iran has revealed fundamental weaknesses in the structure of American military and has turned this confrontation into a full-fledged quagmire for Donald Trump's government. Direct and sustained attacks by Tehran on American military bases in host countries have shattered Washington's longstanding belief in security guarantees as a protective umbrella. The logic of asymmetric warfare has enabled Tehran, relying on suicide weapons and low-cost missiles, to severely deplete and destroy Washington's advanced military capabilities and most vital strategic reserves.

events.title_en: The Strait of Hormuz is irreplaceable
events.summary_en: The Strait of Hormuz is irreplaceable. Reuters reported: Replacing the Strait of Hormuz route with pipelines seems unlikely. The plan to transfer Iraqi oil via a pipeline passing through Syria requires at least four years and 15 billion dollars in funding. Neither Iraq has the capacity to provide 15 billion dollars nor is four years a short timeframe. Furthermore, according to this report, other pipelines such as Al Fujairah pipeline and Saudi Arabia's Eastern pipeline also face major challenges. This report comes as the US Treasury Secretary claimed that within two more years 'more than 50% or 70%' of the region's oil exports will be shipped via underground pipelines.

events.title_en: Security incident for a vessel off Somali coast
events.summary_en: Security incident for a vessel off Somali coast. Britain's Maritime Operations Organisation announced today the receipt of reports of a security incident involving a bulk carrier vessel near the Somali coast. The organisation said in a statement that eight armed individuals boarded the vessel approximately seven kilometres from Port of Kismayo in eastern Somalia and took control of it. Britain's Maritime Operations Organisation, noting that investigations into the details of this incident are continuing, warned other vessels near this location to proceed with caution.

events.title_en: Washington's vertigo at the brink of the precipice
events.summary_en: Washington's vertigo at the brink of the precipice. Defeat against Iran is something that shows itself in the rhetoric and conduct of US government officials. Trump's team is changing, reducing and withdrawing from its original objectives in the regional war with Iran. Six months have passed since the onset of widespread military confrontations in West Asia; a war that began with great fanfare and grand promises from the White House, but has now become a strategic and military quagmire in American history. Donald Trump, in the initial days of this battle, relying on America's vast war machine, sought to achieve clear objectives. He and his team imagined they could reach their goals by applying maximum pressure and attacks.

events.title_en: Unprecedented street protests in India
events.summary_en: Unprecedented street protests in India. Millions of people across India took to the streets in protest against data leaks in the country's national examination digital system. Learning from recent protests in Nepal, famous as the 'Gen Z revolution', the Indian government preferred to make concessions to prevent radicalisation of the situation. The main demand of the protesters was not the minister's resignation, but the calculation of results for applicants who had been excluded from the admission cycle due to system disruption. After weeks of intense protests, the Indian government finally yielded and their results were also calculated in the system.

events.title_en: Brigadier Hosseini: Fuel imbalance is the result of disregard for vehicle safety and technology
events.summary_en: Brigadier Hosseini: Fuel imbalance is the result of disregard for vehicle safety and technology. Head of Traffic Police, referring to the issue of fuel consumption of vehicles, said: For years we have emphasised the necessity of paying attention to vehicle safety and technology. Today everyone has reached the conclusion that if we want to solve traffic problems and issues, we must start organising from precise, effective and impactful sources. We cannot abandon two important sectors and place all issues on the police. Improving road safety, building new roads, removing defects in existing roads and also improving the safety of vehicles, both domestically manufactured and imported vehicles, must receive special attention.

events.title_en: 'We are committed to you until the dawn of appearance'; the special slogan of the fortieth memorial ceremonies for 'the Martyr of Iran'
events.summary_en: 'We are committed to you until the dawn of appearance'; the special slogan of the fortieth memorial ceremonies for 'the Martyr of Iran'. Coinciding with the fortieth day of the funeral and burial of the pure body of the martyred leader, His Eminence Ayatollah Khamenei, and members of his family, the slogan 'We are committed to you until the dawn of appearance' was chosen as the special slogan for the fortieth commemorative ceremonies for 'the Martyr of Iran' throughout the country. This slogan, given the coincidence of the dates of the fortieth memorial ceremonies with the anniversary of the martyrdom of Imam Hassan al-Askari and the beginning of the Imamate of His Eminence the Hujjah son of al-Hasan al-Mahdi, was considered for a set of special programmes to be held in Tehran, Qom, Mashhad and other parts of the country.
